description.value:
Through your connection with your benefactor, you can invoke the power of the drachiri or their respective elements and domains. As you gain in power and the nature of this spiritual connection shifts, this power may change or evolve. When you take this feat, you select a soulstoke focus spell affiliated with a drachiri benefactor. You can only select a spell if you possess a trait that corresponds to that benefactor, which would include benefactors that you do not possess.

If you have @UUID[Compendium.immortal-ardor.archetypes.1inyVlkO2greeK8U]{Bond of Greed} active, you can automatically dismiss it to cast a Soulstoke spell without spending a focus point.

You can take this feat multiple times as you meet new requirements for a benefactor’s trait. Each time you do, you gain a spell you do not have. Any time you gain a new benefactor trait, you can automatically retrain this feat to select another spell if you so choose, and you can retrain your selected spell by spending a week of downtime.
